subject.title: Feature: Subscribe to WhatsApp call events (Baileys)

question: Should the WhatsApp plugin expose only transient sanitized call lifecycle events, or also retain durable per-contact call history for queries such as “contacted today”?
rationale: Transient events can remain a narrow channel capability, while durable history requires decisions about consent, identity resolution, retention, deletion, storage ownership, configuration, and the agent-facing API.

options.title: Transient events first
options.body: Add a default-off sanitized plugin event or typed hook without retaining call history, and consider durable contact tracking separately after its privacy contract is designed.

options.title: Durable contact history
options.body: Store normalized call activity in plugin-owned SQLite with explicit retention, deletion, deduplication, access-control, and query contracts in the same feature design.

options.title: Do not ingest calls
options.body: Leave Baileys call events unconsumed because their communications metadata is outside the desired WhatsApp channel scope.

recommendation.title: Transient events first
recommendation.body: Add a default-off sanitized plugin event or typed hook without retaining call history, and consider durable contact tracking separately after its privacy contract is designed.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the existing scope guidance and recently implemented the adjacent WhatsApp outbound-call capability.
